integrity: The proof uses the published general Gessel–Lucas congruence and an explicitly verifiable finite table. Computations are auxiliary, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Only valuations 0 and 1 and their complementary >=2 stratum are classified; no formula is claimed for individual higher valuations. Bibliographic priority may be limited by unindexed instance-specific automata or equivalent formulations.
title: The first two 29-adic valuation layers of the Franel numbers
